title: Sulfur-Brimstone Resource Pack
description: This .zip file will change all of your sulfur blocks to have the custom name of "Brimstone". If you would like me to add the sulfur cube to this list, just let me know.
body: This custom resource pack instantly changes the name of all the sulfur blocks to have the custom name "Brimstone". If you would like to add the sulfur cube to this list, please let me know. Credit to Mogswamp for the idea.
